source_text:
20.9 Εὑρεθείη ἡ χείρ σου πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχ
θροῖς σου, ἡ δεξιά σου ευ ροι πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε. Εὐεργεσία ἐστὶν ἁμαρτιῶν
ἐκπεσεῖν καὶ ἐννοιῶν πονηρῶν· σπέρμα γὰρ ἁμαρτίας λο γισμὸς πονηρός.
pass_a_gloss: May-it-be-found the hand of-you to-all the enemies of-you, the right-hand of-you may-it-find all the hating you. Benefaction it-is of-sins to-fall-out and of-thoughts wicked; seed for of-sin reasoning wicked.
pass_b_english: “Let your hand be found to all your enemies; let your right hand find all who hate you” (Psalm 20:9).
It is a benefaction to fall out of sins and wicked thoughts; for a wicked reasoning is a seed of sin.

choices.english: it is a benefaction to fall out of sins
choices.why: The hand against enemies is a benefaction, not mere slaughter. OCR λο γισμὸς kept as λογισμός.
rejected: the hand only kills the enemies
falling into sins is the benefaction

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
